This template is to be used for citing individual pages on [[Epic Games]]' [https://www.epicgames.com official website].

==Usage==
Copy the template code below, and paste it into an article's reference note. Fill in as many parameters as you can, remove any that you don't use.

<code><nowiki>{{EpicGames|url=|text=|archivedate=|archiveurl=|nobackup=}}</nowiki></code>

===Required parameters===
*{{Para|url}} URL of the web page, minus the domain name (<code><nowiki>https://www.epicgames.com/</nowiki></code>).
*{{Para|text}} Name of the page being cited.

===Optional parameters===
*{{para|subdomain}} For instances where a subdomain is needed other than <code>www</code>, for example the <code>communities</code> part of <code>https://communities.epicgames.com</code>.

{{BackupLinkHelp}}

===Example(s)===
<code><nowiki>{{EpicGames|url=fortnite/en-US/news/the-force-is-strong-with-fortnite|text=The Force Is Strong With Fortnite|archivedate=20200907082609}}</nowiki></code>

Results in:

{{EpicGames|url=fortnite/en-US/news/the-force-is-strong-with-fortnite|text=The Force Is Strong With Fortnite|archivedate=20200907082609}}

<hr/>
<code><nowiki>{{EpicGames|subdomain=communities|url=thread/mister-bones-arrives-in-droid-tycoon/fE9U|text=MISTER BONES ARRIVES IN DROID TYCOON!|archiveurl=https://megalodon.jp/2026-0601-1658-51/https://communities.epicgames.com:443/thread/mister-bones-arrives-in-droid-tycoon/fE9U}}</nowiki></code>

Results in:

{{EpicGames|subdomain=communities|url=thread/mister-bones-arrives-in-droid-tycoon/fE9U|text=MISTER BONES ARRIVES IN DROID TYCOON!|archiveurl=https://megalodon.jp/2026-0601-1658-51/https://communities.epicgames.com:443/thread/mister-bones-arrives-in-droid-tycoon/fE9U}}
